metadata.description: Root relation anchors for a relation-first TinyStories curriculum.
notes: This graph is the base concept stage, not the TinyStories word attachment stage.
Later words should attach to these anchors by inheritance rather than repeat flat facts.
metadata.title: Root Concept Foundation V0

events: The hand is near the object. The hand moves to the object.
The hand touches the object.
micro_experiences.title: Near Touch

events: The object is far from the hand. The hand moves.
The hand does not touch the object.
micro_experiences.title: Far No Touch

events: The object is inside a closed box. The hand reaches the box.
The closed box blocks the hand.
micro_experiences.title: Closed Blocks

events: The object is inside an open box. The hand reaches inside.
The hand can touch the object.
micro_experiences.title: Open Enables

events: The object is hot. The hand touches the hot object.
Hot touch can cause pain.
micro_experiences.title: Hot Pain

events: The object is sharp. The skin touches the sharp object.
Sharp touch can cause pain.
micro_experiences.title: Sharp Pain

events: The baby feels pain. The caregiver helps the baby.
Help can reduce pain and bring comfort.
micro_experiences.title: Caregiver Comfort

events: The baby is comfortable. The baby feels okay.
Comfort can cause happy feeling.
micro_experiences.title: Comfort Happy

events: The baby feels pain. The pain continues.
Pain can cause sadness.
micro_experiences.title: Pain Sad

events: Mom says a word. The baby hears the word.
A heard word can activate a relation.
micro_experiences.title: Word Activates Relation

nodes.label: thing
nodes.summary: anything that can be related to another thing

nodes.label: relation
nodes.summary: a link between things; the project meaning primitive

nodes.label: object
nodes.summary: a thing that can be touched or moved

nodes.label: self
nodes.summary: things directly controlled and directly felt

nodes.label: hand
nodes.summary: body part used to reach, touch, push, pull

nodes.label: mouth
nodes.summary: body part used to eat, taste, cry, speak

nodes.label: skin
nodes.summary: body surface that feels touch and pain

nodes.label: leg
nodes.summary: body part used to move from place to place

nodes.label: dry
nodes.summary: does not have water on it

nodes.label: living thing
nodes.summary: thing that can grow or need

nodes.label: animal
nodes.summary: living thing that can move and feel

nodes.label: plant
nodes.summary: living thing that grows but usually does not move like animal

nodes.label: young animal
nodes.summary: young animal, often small and dependent

nodes.label: sad
nodes.summary: negative feeling from loss, pain, or broken relation

nodes.label: angry
nodes.summary: negative feeling when wanted state is blocked

nodes.label: want
nodes.summary: pull toward a state or object

nodes.label: help
nodes.summary: action that reduces problem or pain

nodes.label: hurt
nodes.summary: action that causes pain or damage

nodes.label: give
nodes.summary: move object from one person to another

nodes.label: take
nodes.summary: get object from another place or person

nodes.label: share
nodes.summary: let another person use or have too

nodes.label: role
nodes.summary: a social position that changes expected relations

nodes.label: pet
nodes.summary: animal living near people and cared for by people

nodes.label: word
nodes.summary: sound or text that can name a concept

nodes.label: name
nodes.summary: word used for a thing or person

nodes.label: question
nodes.summary: words asking for a relation or state

nodes.label: answer
nodes.summary: words giving a relation or state

nodes.label: effect
nodes.summary: later relation caused by earlier relation
